verdict.rationale: Gmail's own filters let users define rules that match incoming messages by sender, subject, or size and automatically add or remove labels or forward the email, so the core of the story is delivered. The documented trigger is limited to incoming-message matching and the action set is narrow; push notifications only tell an external backend that the mailbox changed. missing for 10: triggers beyond incoming-message matching (other event types), a broader documented action set beyond labeling and forwarding, independent or hands-on corroboration of rule behavior.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: When a message matches, filters automatically trigger actions such as adding or removing labels, or forwarding the email to a specified address.
Advanced rules configured for an account that evaluate incoming messages against specific matching criteria (like sender, subject, or size).
After you search, you can use the results to set up a filter for these messages.
